# Power Without War: capacity, per-resource effects (model, tunables and the
# public interface: pww_cap_core.txt).
#
#   pww_cap_tick_<res>     (country) read the signals, move the factor one
#                          monthly step, write pww_cap_<res>, pww_cap_trend_<res>,
#                          pww_cap_spare_<res> and the modifier value
#                          pww_cap_m_<res>. Needs temp pww_cpk_lrf (1 +
#                          local_resources_factor when c_comp = 1, else 1).
#   pww_cap_world_refresh  (any) global.pww_cap_rho_<res>
###############################################################################

### oil

pww_cap_tick_oil = {
	# Extraction (own output): produced is net of costs and includes
	# inflows, so add the costs back and take the inflows out.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_p = resource_produced@oil }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cpk_p }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_in_oil }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_out_oil }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cap_oil } }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_oil = 1 }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_oil = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cap_oil }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_own > global.pww_cap_c_min_out } }
		# Export share in force: the pool on offer over production.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_x = resource_exported@oil }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_p > 0.5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_x }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_p }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_e min = 0 max = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = pww_cpk_e }
		# Natural balance: resource@ without our lanes' holding, storage costs,
		# reserve draws and dumps (each moves the balance by (1 - e) of itself).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_b = resource@oil }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = 0 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cpk_ne }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_b }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_lf }
		# Unsold = natural balance less what storage takes; spare = unsold
		# beyond the working margin (c_margin of extraction).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_stin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = global.pww_cap_c_margin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_u }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_m }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_spare_oil = pww_cpk_s }

		# Own shortage: without vanilla imports and contract purchases the
		# country's own balance is negative (it imports, draws reserves or
		# goes without).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = resource_imported@oil }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_lf_in_oil }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_ne }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_t }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = resource_consumed@oil }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_share }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_tol < global.pww_cap_c_short_min } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_min } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_bo < pww_cpk_tol } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
		}

		# World market: the share of the world's open-market pool that buyers
		# take (global.pww_cap_rho_<res>). Nobody idles below c_rho_mult x
		# that share (vanilla buyers keep their imports); a tight world
		# market (share over c_pool_full) is demand.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_rho = global.pww_cap_rho_oil }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = pww_cpk_rho }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_rho_mult }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl < global.pww_cap_c_floor } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_floor } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_rho > global.pww_cap_c_pool_full } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
		}

		# Other demand: contract buyers are taking the working stock, a buyer
		# was turned away (country var pww_cap_turned_oil = the day), test hook.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_m }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_low_stock }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_u < pww_cpk_t }
				check_variable = { pww_lf_out_oil > 0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_turned_oil }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cap_turned_oil }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_t < global.pww_cap_c_turned_days } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
			}
		}
		# Oil: fuel tanks running low (war) are demand for oil.
		if = {
			limit = { fuel_ratio < 0.5 }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_test_demand_oil }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > 0 } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
		}

		# May this output idle? Spare persists, storage takes nothing more,
		# the factor stays above the world-market floor, and the economic
		# system allows it.
		# Deadband: idle only when spare exceeds c_idle_band of extraction, so
		# a seller at balance neither idles nor expands.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_fl }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = global.pww_cap_c_idle_band }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > pww_cpk_bd }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > pww_cpk_t }
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 }
			# Spare oil fills the fuel tanks: idle only once they are full.
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { fuel_ratio > 0.95 } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
			# Command economy: keeps output it uses for war production.
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_use = resource_consumed@oil }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_use > global.pww_cap_c_mil_use }
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_idle }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_fl } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Reopen idle output: sold out, or idled below the world-market floor.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < 0.999 }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_reopen }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Invest: a market economy for any buyer; planned and command
			# economies only where the country itself is short.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 0.998 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < global.pww_cap_c_ceiling }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_market }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_planned } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_command } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_t }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_cap_oil = pww_cpk_cap }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_oil = pww_cpk_tr }
	# Modifier value: the factor relative to vanilla output. The per-resource
	# factor adds to local_resources_factor (technology), so scale by it.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cap_oil }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cpk_lrf }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_oil = pww_cpk_mv }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cap_debug }
		log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CAP [This.GetTag] oil sys=[?pww_cap_sys|0] cap=[?pww_cap_oil|3] trend=[?pww_cap_trend_oil|0] own=[?pww_cpk_own|1] bal=[?pww_cpk_b|1] unsold=[?pww_cpk_u|1] spare=[?pww_cpk_s|1] pool=[?pww_cpk_x|1] rho=[?pww_cpk_rho|3] fl=[?pww_cpk_fl|2] short=[?pww_cpk_short|0] dmd=[?pww_cpk_dmd|0] ok=[?pww_cpk_ok|0]"
	}
}

### aluminium

pww_cap_tick_aluminium = {
	# Extraction (own output): produced is net of costs and includes
	# inflows, so add the costs back and take the inflows out.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_p = resource_produced@aluminium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cpk_p }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_in_aluminium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_out_aluminium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_dump_aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_out_aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_cost_aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_hold_aluminium }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cap_aluminium } }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_aluminium = 1 }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_aluminium = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cap_aluminium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_own > global.pww_cap_c_min_out } }
		# Export share in force: the pool on offer over production.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_x = resource_exported@aluminium }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_p > 0.5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_x }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_p }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_e min = 0 max = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = pww_cpk_e }
		# Natural balance: resource@ without our lanes' holding, storage costs,
		# reserve draws and dumps (each moves the balance by (1 - e) of itself).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_b = resource@aluminium }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_cost_aluminium }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_hold_aluminium }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_out_aluminium }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_dump_aluminium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cpk_ne }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_b }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_lf }
		# Unsold = natural balance less what storage takes; spare = unsold
		# beyond the working margin (c_margin of extraction).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = pww_stock_in_aluminium }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_stin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = global.pww_cap_c_margin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_u }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_m }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_spare_aluminium = pww_cpk_s }

		# Own shortage: without vanilla imports and contract purchases the
		# country's own balance is negative (it imports, draws reserves or
		# goes without).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = resource_imported@aluminium }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_lf_in_aluminium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_ne }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_t }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = resource_consumed@aluminium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_share }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_tol < global.pww_cap_c_short_min } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_min } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_bo < pww_cpk_tol } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
		}

		# World market: the share of the world's open-market pool that buyers
		# take (global.pww_cap_rho_<res>). Nobody idles below c_rho_mult x
		# that share (vanilla buyers keep their imports); a tight world
		# market (share over c_pool_full) is demand.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_rho = global.pww_cap_rho_aluminium }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = pww_cpk_rho }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_rho_mult }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl < global.pww_cap_c_floor } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_floor } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_rho > global.pww_cap_c_pool_full } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
		}

		# Other demand: contract buyers are taking the working stock, a buyer
		# was turned away (country var pww_cap_turned_aluminium = the day), test hook.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_m }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_low_stock }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_u < pww_cpk_t }
				check_variable = { pww_lf_out_aluminium > 0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_turned_aluminium }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cap_turned_aluminium }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_t < global.pww_cap_c_turned_days } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_test_demand_aluminium }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > 0 } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
		}

		# May this output idle? Spare persists, storage takes nothing more,
		# the factor stays above the world-market floor, and the economic
		# system allows it.
		# Deadband: idle only when spare exceeds c_idle_band of extraction, so
		# a seller at balance neither idles nor expands.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_fl }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = global.pww_cap_c_idle_band }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > pww_cpk_bd }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > pww_cpk_t }
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 }
			# Storage fills first: no idling while the reserve still takes output.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_stin > 0.099 }
					NOT = { pww_stock_full_aluminium = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
			# Command economy: keeps output it uses for war production.
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_use = resource_consumed@aluminium }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_use > global.pww_cap_c_mil_use }
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_idle }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_fl } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Reopen idle output: sold out, or idled below the world-market floor.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < 0.999 }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_reopen }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Invest: a market economy for any buyer; planned and command
			# economies only where the country itself is short.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 0.998 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < global.pww_cap_c_ceiling }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_market }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_planned } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_command } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_t }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_cap_aluminium = pww_cpk_cap }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_aluminium = pww_cpk_tr }
	# Modifier value: the factor relative to vanilla output. The per-resource
	# factor adds to local_resources_factor (technology), so scale by it.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cap_aluminium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cpk_lrf }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_aluminium = pww_cpk_mv }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cap_debug }
		log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CAP [This.GetTag] aluminium sys=[?pww_cap_sys|0] cap=[?pww_cap_aluminium|3] trend=[?pww_cap_trend_aluminium|0] own=[?pww_cpk_own|1] bal=[?pww_cpk_b|1] unsold=[?pww_cpk_u|1] spare=[?pww_cpk_s|1] pool=[?pww_cpk_x|1] rho=[?pww_cpk_rho|3] fl=[?pww_cpk_fl|2] short=[?pww_cpk_short|0] dmd=[?pww_cpk_dmd|0] ok=[?pww_cpk_ok|0]"
	}
}

### rubber

pww_cap_tick_rubber = {
	# Extraction (own output): produced is net of costs and includes
	# inflows, so add the costs back and take the inflows out.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_p = resource_produced@rubber }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cpk_p }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_in_rubber }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_out_rubber }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_dump_rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_out_rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_cost_rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_hold_rubber }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cap_rubber } }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_rubber = 1 }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_rubber = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cap_rubber }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_own > global.pww_cap_c_min_out } }
		# Export share in force: the pool on offer over production.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_x = resource_exported@rubber }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_p > 0.5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_x }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_p }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_e min = 0 max = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = pww_cpk_e }
		# Natural balance: resource@ without our lanes' holding, storage costs,
		# reserve draws and dumps (each moves the balance by (1 - e) of itself).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_b = resource@rubber }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_cost_rubber }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_hold_rubber }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_out_rubber }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_dump_rubber }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cpk_ne }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_b }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_lf }
		# Unsold = natural balance less what storage takes; spare = unsold
		# beyond the working margin (c_margin of extraction).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = pww_stock_in_rubber }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_stin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = global.pww_cap_c_margin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_u }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_m }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_spare_rubber = pww_cpk_s }

		# Own shortage: without vanilla imports and contract purchases the
		# country's own balance is negative (it imports, draws reserves or
		# goes without).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = resource_imported@rubber }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_lf_in_rubber }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_ne }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_t }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = resource_consumed@rubber }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_share }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_tol < global.pww_cap_c_short_min } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_min } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_bo < pww_cpk_tol } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
		}

		# World market: the share of the world's open-market pool that buyers
		# take (global.pww_cap_rho_<res>). Nobody idles below c_rho_mult x
		# that share (vanilla buyers keep their imports); a tight world
		# market (share over c_pool_full) is demand.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_rho = global.pww_cap_rho_rubber }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = pww_cpk_rho }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_rho_mult }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl < global.pww_cap_c_floor } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_floor } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_rho > global.pww_cap_c_pool_full } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
		}

		# Other demand: contract buyers are taking the working stock, a buyer
		# was turned away (country var pww_cap_turned_rubber = the day), test hook.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_m }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_low_stock }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_u < pww_cpk_t }
				check_variable = { pww_lf_out_rubber > 0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_turned_rubber }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cap_turned_rubber }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_t < global.pww_cap_c_turned_days } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_test_demand_rubber }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > 0 } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
		}

		# May this output idle? Spare persists, storage takes nothing more,
		# the factor stays above the world-market floor, and the economic
		# system allows it.
		# Deadband: idle only when spare exceeds c_idle_band of extraction, so
		# a seller at balance neither idles nor expands.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_fl }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = global.pww_cap_c_idle_band }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > pww_cpk_bd }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > pww_cpk_t }
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 }
			# Storage fills first: no idling while the reserve still takes output.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_stin > 0.099 }
					NOT = { pww_stock_full_rubber = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
			# Command economy: keeps output it uses for war production.
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_use = resource_consumed@rubber }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_use > global.pww_cap_c_mil_use }
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_idle }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_fl } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Reopen idle output: sold out, or idled below the world-market floor.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < 0.999 }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_reopen }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Invest: a market economy for any buyer; planned and command
			# economies only where the country itself is short.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 0.998 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < global.pww_cap_c_ceiling }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_market }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_planned } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_command } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_t }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_cap_rubber = pww_cpk_cap }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_rubber = pww_cpk_tr }
	# Modifier value: the factor relative to vanilla output. The per-resource
	# factor adds to local_resources_factor (technology), so scale by it.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cap_rubber }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cpk_lrf }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_rubber = pww_cpk_mv }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cap_debug }
		log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CAP [This.GetTag] rubber sys=[?pww_cap_sys|0] cap=[?pww_cap_rubber|3] trend=[?pww_cap_trend_rubber|0] own=[?pww_cpk_own|1] bal=[?pww_cpk_b|1] unsold=[?pww_cpk_u|1] spare=[?pww_cpk_s|1] pool=[?pww_cpk_x|1] rho=[?pww_cpk_rho|3] fl=[?pww_cpk_fl|2] short=[?pww_cpk_short|0] dmd=[?pww_cpk_dmd|0] ok=[?pww_cpk_ok|0]"
	}
}

### tungsten

pww_cap_tick_tungsten = {
	# Extraction (own output): produced is net of costs and includes
	# inflows, so add the costs back and take the inflows out.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_p = resource_produced@tungsten }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cpk_p }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_in_tungsten }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_out_tungsten }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_dump_tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_out_tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_cost_tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_hold_tungsten }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cap_tungsten } }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_tungsten = 1 }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_tungsten = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cap_tungsten }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_own > global.pww_cap_c_min_out } }
		# Export share in force: the pool on offer over production.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_x = resource_exported@tungsten }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_p > 0.5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_x }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_p }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_e min = 0 max = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = pww_cpk_e }
		# Natural balance: resource@ without our lanes' holding, storage costs,
		# reserve draws and dumps (each moves the balance by (1 - e) of itself).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_b = resource@tungsten }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_cost_tungsten }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_hold_tungsten }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_out_tungsten }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_dump_tungsten }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cpk_ne }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_b }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_lf }
		# Unsold = natural balance less what storage takes; spare = unsold
		# beyond the working margin (c_margin of extraction).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = pww_stock_in_tungsten }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_stin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = global.pww_cap_c_margin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_u }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_m }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_spare_tungsten = pww_cpk_s }

		# Own shortage: without vanilla imports and contract purchases the
		# country's own balance is negative (it imports, draws reserves or
		# goes without).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = resource_imported@tungsten }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_lf_in_tungsten }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_ne }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_t }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = resource_consumed@tungsten }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_share }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_tol < global.pww_cap_c_short_min } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_min } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_bo < pww_cpk_tol } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
		}

		# World market: the share of the world's open-market pool that buyers
		# take (global.pww_cap_rho_<res>). Nobody idles below c_rho_mult x
		# that share (vanilla buyers keep their imports); a tight world
		# market (share over c_pool_full) is demand.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_rho = global.pww_cap_rho_tungsten }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = pww_cpk_rho }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_rho_mult }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl < global.pww_cap_c_floor } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_floor } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_rho > global.pww_cap_c_pool_full } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
		}

		# Other demand: contract buyers are taking the working stock, a buyer
		# was turned away (country var pww_cap_turned_tungsten = the day), test hook.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_m }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_low_stock }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_u < pww_cpk_t }
				check_variable = { pww_lf_out_tungsten > 0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_turned_tungsten }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cap_turned_tungsten }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_t < global.pww_cap_c_turned_days } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_test_demand_tungsten }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > 0 } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
		}

		# May this output idle? Spare persists, storage takes nothing more,
		# the factor stays above the world-market floor, and the economic
		# system allows it.
		# Deadband: idle only when spare exceeds c_idle_band of extraction, so
		# a seller at balance neither idles nor expands.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_fl }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = global.pww_cap_c_idle_band }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > pww_cpk_bd }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > pww_cpk_t }
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 }
			# Storage fills first: no idling while the reserve still takes output.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_stin > 0.099 }
					NOT = { pww_stock_full_tungsten = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
			# Command economy: keeps output it uses for war production.
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_use = resource_consumed@tungsten }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_use > global.pww_cap_c_mil_use }
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_idle }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_fl } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Reopen idle output: sold out, or idled below the world-market floor.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < 0.999 }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_reopen }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Invest: a market economy for any buyer; planned and command
			# economies only where the country itself is short.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 0.998 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < global.pww_cap_c_ceiling }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_market }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_planned } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_command } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_t }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_cap_tungsten = pww_cpk_cap }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_tungsten = pww_cpk_tr }
	# Modifier value: the factor relative to vanilla output. The per-resource
	# factor adds to local_resources_factor (technology), so scale by it.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cap_tungsten }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cpk_lrf }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_tungsten = pww_cpk_mv }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cap_debug }
		log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CAP [This.GetTag] tungsten sys=[?pww_cap_sys|0] cap=[?pww_cap_tungsten|3] trend=[?pww_cap_trend_tungsten|0] own=[?pww_cpk_own|1] bal=[?pww_cpk_b|1] unsold=[?pww_cpk_u|1] spare=[?pww_cpk_s|1] pool=[?pww_cpk_x|1] rho=[?pww_cpk_rho|3] fl=[?pww_cpk_fl|2] short=[?pww_cpk_short|0] dmd=[?pww_cpk_dmd|0] ok=[?pww_cpk_ok|0]"
	}
}

### steel

pww_cap_tick_steel = {
	# Extraction (own output): produced is net of costs and includes
	# inflows, so add the costs back and take the inflows out.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_p = resource_produced@steel }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cpk_p }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_in_steel }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_out_steel }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_dump_steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_out_steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_cost_steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_hold_steel }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cap_steel } }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_steel = 1 }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_steel = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cap_steel }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_own > global.pww_cap_c_min_out } }
		# Export share in force: the pool on offer over production.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_x = resource_exported@steel }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_p > 0.5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_x }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_p }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_e min = 0 max = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = pww_cpk_e }
		# Natural balance: resource@ without our lanes' holding, storage costs,
		# reserve draws and dumps (each moves the balance by (1 - e) of itself).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_b = resource@steel }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_cost_steel }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_hold_steel }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_out_steel }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_dump_steel }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cpk_ne }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_b }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_lf }
		# Unsold = natural balance less what storage takes; spare = unsold
		# beyond the working margin (c_margin of extraction).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = pww_stock_in_steel }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_stin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = global.pww_cap_c_margin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_u }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_m }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_spare_steel = pww_cpk_s }

		# Own shortage: without vanilla imports and contract purchases the
		# country's own balance is negative (it imports, draws reserves or
		# goes without).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = resource_imported@steel }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_lf_in_steel }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_ne }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_t }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = resource_consumed@steel }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_share }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_tol < global.pww_cap_c_short_min } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_min } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_bo < pww_cpk_tol } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
		}

		# World market: the share of the world's open-market pool that buyers
		# take (global.pww_cap_rho_<res>). Nobody idles below c_rho_mult x
		# that share (vanilla buyers keep their imports); a tight world
		# market (share over c_pool_full) is demand.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_rho = global.pww_cap_rho_steel }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = pww_cpk_rho }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_rho_mult }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl < global.pww_cap_c_floor } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_floor } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_rho > global.pww_cap_c_pool_full } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
		}

		# Other demand: contract buyers are taking the working stock, a buyer
		# was turned away (country var pww_cap_turned_steel = the day), test hook.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_m }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_low_stock }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_u < pww_cpk_t }
				check_variable = { pww_lf_out_steel > 0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_turned_steel }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cap_turned_steel }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_t < global.pww_cap_c_turned_days } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_test_demand_steel }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > 0 } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
		}

		# May this output idle? Spare persists, storage takes nothing more,
		# the factor stays above the world-market floor, and the economic
		# system allows it.
		# Deadband: idle only when spare exceeds c_idle_band of extraction, so
		# a seller at balance neither idles nor expands.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_fl }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = global.pww_cap_c_idle_band }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > pww_cpk_bd }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > pww_cpk_t }
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 }
			# Storage fills first: no idling while the reserve still takes output.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_stin > 0.099 }
					NOT = { pww_stock_full_steel = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
			# Command economy: keeps output it uses for war production.
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_use = resource_consumed@steel }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_use > global.pww_cap_c_mil_use }
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_idle }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_fl } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Reopen idle output: sold out, or idled below the world-market floor.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < 0.999 }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_reopen }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Invest: a market economy for any buyer; planned and command
			# economies only where the country itself is short.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 0.998 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < global.pww_cap_c_ceiling }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_market }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_planned } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_command } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_t }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_cap_steel = pww_cpk_cap }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_steel = pww_cpk_tr }
	# Modifier value: the factor relative to vanilla output. The per-resource
	# factor adds to local_resources_factor (technology), so scale by it.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cap_steel }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cpk_lrf }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_steel = pww_cpk_mv }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cap_debug }
		log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CAP [This.GetTag] steel sys=[?pww_cap_sys|0] cap=[?pww_cap_steel|3] trend=[?pww_cap_trend_steel|0] own=[?pww_cpk_own|1] bal=[?pww_cpk_b|1] unsold=[?pww_cpk_u|1] spare=[?pww_cpk_s|1] pool=[?pww_cpk_x|1] rho=[?pww_cpk_rho|3] fl=[?pww_cpk_fl|2] short=[?pww_cpk_short|0] dmd=[?pww_cpk_dmd|0] ok=[?pww_cpk_ok|0]"
	}
}

### chromium

pww_cap_tick_chromium = {
	# Extraction (own output): produced is net of costs and includes
	# inflows, so add the costs back and take the inflows out.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_p = resource_produced@chromium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cpk_p }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_in_chromium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_out_chromium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_dump_chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_out_chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_cost_chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_hold_chromium }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cap_chromium } }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_chromium = 1 }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_chromium = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cap_chromium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_own > global.pww_cap_c_min_out } }
		# Export share in force: the pool on offer over production.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_x = resource_exported@chromium }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_p > 0.5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_x }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_p }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_e min = 0 max = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = pww_cpk_e }
		# Natural balance: resource@ without our lanes' holding, storage costs,
		# reserve draws and dumps (each moves the balance by (1 - e) of itself).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_b = resource@chromium }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_cost_chromium }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_hold_chromium }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_out_chromium }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_dump_chromium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cpk_ne }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_b }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_lf }
		# Unsold = natural balance less what storage takes; spare = unsold
		# beyond the working margin (c_margin of extraction).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = pww_stock_in_chromium }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_stin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = global.pww_cap_c_margin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_u }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_m }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_spare_chromium = pww_cpk_s }

		# Own shortage: without vanilla imports and contract purchases the
		# country's own balance is negative (it imports, draws reserves or
		# goes without).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = resource_imported@chromium }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_lf_in_chromium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_ne }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_t }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = resource_consumed@chromium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_share }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_tol < global.pww_cap_c_short_min } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_min } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_bo < pww_cpk_tol } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
		}

		# World market: the share of the world's open-market pool that buyers
		# take (global.pww_cap_rho_<res>). Nobody idles below c_rho_mult x
		# that share (vanilla buyers keep their imports); a tight world
		# market (share over c_pool_full) is demand.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_rho = global.pww_cap_rho_chromium }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = pww_cpk_rho }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_rho_mult }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl < global.pww_cap_c_floor } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_floor } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_rho > global.pww_cap_c_pool_full } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
		}

		# Other demand: contract buyers are taking the working stock, a buyer
		# was turned away (country var pww_cap_turned_chromium = the day), test hook.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_m }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_low_stock }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_u < pww_cpk_t }
				check_variable = { pww_lf_out_chromium > 0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_turned_chromium }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cap_turned_chromium }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_t < global.pww_cap_c_turned_days } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_test_demand_chromium }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > 0 } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
		}

		# May this output idle? Spare persists, storage takes nothing more,
		# the factor stays above the world-market floor, and the economic
		# system allows it.
		# Deadband: idle only when spare exceeds c_idle_band of extraction, so
		# a seller at balance neither idles nor expands.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_fl }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = global.pww_cap_c_idle_band }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > pww_cpk_bd }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > pww_cpk_t }
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 }
			# Storage fills first: no idling while the reserve still takes output.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_stin > 0.099 }
					NOT = { pww_stock_full_chromium = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
			# Command economy: keeps output it uses for war production.
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_use = resource_consumed@chromium }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_use > global.pww_cap_c_mil_use }
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_idle }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_fl } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Reopen idle output: sold out, or idled below the world-market floor.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < 0.999 }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_reopen }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Invest: a market economy for any buyer; planned and command
			# economies only where the country itself is short.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 0.998 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < global.pww_cap_c_ceiling }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_market }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_planned } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_command } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_t }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_cap_chromium = pww_cpk_cap }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_chromium = pww_cpk_tr }
	# Modifier value: the factor relative to vanilla output. The per-resource
	# factor adds to local_resources_factor (technology), so scale by it.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cap_chromium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cpk_lrf }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_chromium = pww_cpk_mv }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cap_debug }
		log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CAP [This.GetTag] chromium sys=[?pww_cap_sys|0] cap=[?pww_cap_chromium|3] trend=[?pww_cap_trend_chromium|0] own=[?pww_cpk_own|1] bal=[?pww_cpk_b|1] unsold=[?pww_cpk_u|1] spare=[?pww_cpk_s|1] pool=[?pww_cpk_x|1] rho=[?pww_cpk_rho|3] fl=[?pww_cpk_fl|2] short=[?pww_cpk_short|0] dmd=[?pww_cpk_dmd|0] ok=[?pww_cpk_ok|0]"
	}
}

### coal

pww_cap_tick_coal = {
	# Extraction (own output): produced is net of costs and includes
	# inflows, so add the costs back and take the inflows out.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_p = resource_produced@coal }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cpk_p }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_in_coal }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_out_coal }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_dump_coal }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_lf_out_coal }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_stock_cost_coal }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_own = pww_cartel_hold_coal }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cap_coal } }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_coal = 1 }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_coal = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cap_coal }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_own > global.pww_cap_c_min_out } }
		# Export share in force: the pool on offer over production.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_x = resource_exported@coal }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_p > 0.5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_x }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_e = pww_cpk_p }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_e min = 0 max = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ne = pww_cpk_e }
		# Natural balance: resource@ without our lanes' holding, storage costs,
		# reserve draws and dumps (each moves the balance by (1 - e) of itself).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_b = resource@coal }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_cost_coal }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_hold_coal }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_stock_out_coal }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cartel_dump_coal }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_lf = pww_cpk_ne }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_b }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bn = pww_cpk_lf }
		# Unsold = natural balance less what storage takes; spare = unsold
		# beyond the working margin (c_margin of extraction).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_stin = pww_stock_in_coal }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_u = pww_cpk_stin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_m = global.pww_cap_c_margin }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_u }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_s = pww_cpk_m }
		set_variable = { pww_cap_spare_coal = pww_cpk_s }

		# Own shortage: without vanilla imports and contract purchases the
		# country's own balance is negative (it imports, draws reserves or
		# goes without).
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_bn }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = resource_imported@coal }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_lf_in_coal }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_ne }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bo = pww_cpk_t }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = resource_consumed@coal }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_share }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_tol < global.pww_cap_c_short_min } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = global.pww_cap_c_short_min } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tol = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_bo < pww_cpk_tol } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
		}

		# World market: the share of the world's open-market pool that buyers
		# take (global.pww_cap_rho_<res>). Nobody idles below c_rho_mult x
		# that share (vanilla buyers keep their imports); a tight world
		# market (share over c_pool_full) is demand.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_rho = global.pww_cap_rho_coal }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = pww_cpk_rho }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_rho_mult }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl < global.pww_cap_c_floor } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = global.pww_cap_c_floor } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_fl > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_fl = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_rho > global.pww_cap_c_pool_full } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
		}

		# Other demand: contract buyers are taking the working stock, a buyer
		# was turned away (country var pww_cap_turned_coal = the day), test hook.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_m }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_low_stock }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_u < pww_cpk_t }
				check_variable = { pww_lf_out_coal > 0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_turned_coal }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cap_turned_coal }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_t < global.pww_cap_c_turned_days } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pww_cap_test_demand_coal }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > 0 } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_full = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_dmd = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
		}

		# May this output idle? Spare persists, storage takes nothing more,
		# the factor stays above the world-market floor, and the economic
		# system allows it.
		# Deadband: idle only when spare exceeds c_idle_band of extraction, so
		# a seller at balance neither idles nor expands.
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = pww_cpk_fl }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = pww_cpk_own }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_bd = global.pww_cap_c_idle_band }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_s > pww_cpk_bd }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > pww_cpk_t }
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 }
			# Storage fills first: no idling while the reserve still takes output.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = pww_stock_loaded
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_stin > 0.099 }
					NOT = { pww_stock_full_coal = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
			# Command economy: keeps output it uses for war production.
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_use = resource_consumed@coal }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_use > global.pww_cap_c_mil_use }
						check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 0 }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_ok = 1 } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_idle }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_fl } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Reopen idle output: sold out, or idled below the world-market floor.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < 0.999 }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < pww_cpk_fl }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_reopen }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			# Invest: a market economy for any buyer; planned and command
			# economies only where the country itself is short.
			limit = {
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_sold = 1 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > 0.998 }
				check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap < global.pww_cap_c_ceiling }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_cpk_short = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_market }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_planned } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cap_sys = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_t = global.pww_cap_c_invest_command } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = pww_cpk_t }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_cap > global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_cap = global.pww_cap_c_ceiling } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_tr = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_cap_coal = pww_cpk_cap }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_coal = pww_cpk_tr }
	# Modifier value: the factor relative to vanilla output. The per-resource
	# factor adds to local_resources_factor (technology), so scale by it.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cap_coal }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_mv = pww_cpk_lrf }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_coal = pww_cpk_mv }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cap_debug }
		log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CAP [This.GetTag] coal sys=[?pww_cap_sys|0] cap=[?pww_cap_coal|3] trend=[?pww_cap_trend_coal|0] own=[?pww_cpk_own|1] bal=[?pww_cpk_b|1] unsold=[?pww_cpk_u|1] spare=[?pww_cpk_s|1] pool=[?pww_cpk_x|1] rho=[?pww_cpk_rho|3] fl=[?pww_cpk_fl|2] short=[?pww_cpk_short|0] dmd=[?pww_cpk_dmd|0] ok=[?pww_cpk_ok|0]"
	}
}

# Any scope. Per resource, the share of the world's open-market pool that
# buyers take: global.pww_cap_rho_<res> = world imports / world pool.
pww_cap_world_refresh = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = resource_exported@oil }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = resource_imported@oil }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_wx < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 1 } }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = pww_cpk_wx }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_wi min = 0 max = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_cap_rho_oil = pww_cpk_wi }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = resource_exported@aluminium }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = resource_imported@aluminium }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_wx < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 1 } }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = pww_cpk_wx }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_wi min = 0 max = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_cap_rho_aluminium = pww_cpk_wi }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = resource_exported@rubber }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = resource_imported@rubber }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_wx < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 1 } }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = pww_cpk_wx }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_wi min = 0 max = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_cap_rho_rubber = pww_cpk_wi }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = resource_exported@tungsten }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = resource_imported@tungsten }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_wx < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 1 } }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = pww_cpk_wx }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_wi min = 0 max = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_cap_rho_tungsten = pww_cpk_wi }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = resource_exported@steel }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = resource_imported@steel }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_wx < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 1 } }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = pww_cpk_wx }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_wi min = 0 max = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_cap_rho_steel = pww_cpk_wi }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = resource_exported@chromium }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = resource_imported@chromium }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_wx < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 1 } }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = pww_cpk_wx }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_wi min = 0 max = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_cap_rho_chromium = pww_cpk_wi }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = resource_exported@coal }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = resource_imported@coal }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_cpk_wx < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wx = 1 } }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_cpk_wi = pww_cpk_wx }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_cpk_wi min = 0 max = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_cap_rho_coal = pww_cpk_wi }
	set_variable = { global.pww_cap_world_day = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cap_debug }
		log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CAP world rho oil=[?global.pww_cap_rho_oil|3] alu=[?global.pww_cap_rho_aluminium|3] rub=[?global.pww_cap_rho_rubber|3] tun=[?global.pww_cap_rho_tungsten|3] ste=[?global.pww_cap_rho_steel|3] chr=[?global.pww_cap_rho_chromium|3] coa=[?global.pww_cap_rho_coal|3]"
	}
}

# All seven resources (called by pww_cap_core.txt).
pww_cap_tick_all = {
	pww_cap_tick_oil = yes
	pww_cap_tick_aluminium = yes
	pww_cap_tick_rubber = yes
	pww_cap_tick_tungsten = yes
	pww_cap_tick_steel = yes
	pww_cap_tick_chromium = yes
	pww_cap_tick_coal = yes
}

# Country scope. Resets every factor to vanilla (pww_cap_reset).
pww_cap_reset_all = {
	set_variable = { pww_cap_oil = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_oil = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_oil = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_aluminium = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_aluminium = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_aluminium = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_rubber = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_rubber = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_rubber = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_tungsten = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_tungsten = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_tungsten = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_steel = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_steel = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_steel = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_chromium = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_chromium = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_chromium = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_coal = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_trend_coal = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_cap_m_coal = 0 }
}
